capex_override.ack_reason: Out-of-band by construction: the band anchors on the last FILED capex value under an engine-read tag, which is the FY2018 PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment fact of $1,477,000 — the minor field-service-assets line, not the filer's E&P capex at all (RRC's actual capex is filed only as PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasPropertyAndEquipment plus acreage purchases, per the source). The override is not an estimate lacking an anchor — it is the median of the filer's own FY2023-25 cash-flow totals from its FY2025 10-K.
capex_override.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under every candidate tag the engine reads: RRC's real E&P capex is filed as PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasPropertyAndEquipment (discontinued sibling PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasProperty ends FY2018), which is not in the engine's tag list, and the only rollup tag it does read (PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment) ends at FY2018 with the minor field-service line ($1,477,000 in FY2018). The engine applies this single value to every missing period; it is the median of the filer's own FY2023-25 total cash capex (all three investing lines above). Against the true per-year totals it overstates FY2023 capex by $21,650,000 (conservative direction — lowers that year's OE), is exact for FY2024, and understates FY2025 capex by $12,935,000 (flatters the latest year by ~1.1% of FY2025 OCF — noted, not hidden). Excluded: purchases of marketable securities for the deferred compensation plan ($23,117,000 in FY2025) — a compensation-plan investment, not capex.
capex_override.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-24, accession 0001193125-26-067292), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities (in thousands): 'Additions to natural gas, NGLs and oil properties' $581,489 (FY2025) / $570,426 (FY2024) / $571,819 (FY2023) — tagged us-gaap PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasPropertyAndEquipment, a tag the engine does not read; 'Acreage purchases' $56,814 / $56,085 / $34,410; 'Additions to field service assets and other' $3,212 / $2,069 / $701. Total cash capex by year: FY2023 $606,930,000, FY2024 $628,580,000, FY2025 $641,515,000; the override value is the median of the three filed years (the FY2024 total).

moat_against: Pure commodity price-taker: no pricing power over natural gas or NGL prices, and OE/share has swung more than 3x in five years with the strip (OE_VOLATILE)
Single-basin concentration in Appalachia: pipeline takeaway limits and state/federal permitting cap growth and can blow out basis differentials
Depleting asset: the FY2026 capital budget is $650-700M just to grow production modestly (guided 2.35-2.40 Bcfe/d) — reinvestment is not optional
Returns are the cycle, not a franchise: fundamentals.json roic_proxy is null (operating income is untagged) and filed ROE swung from -43% in FY2020 to +41% in FY2022 (fundamentals.json annual series)
moat_for: Low-cost Marcellus core: southwest Pennsylvania acreage in the lowest-cost U.S. gas basin; all-in capital spending of $0.83 per mcfe in FY2025 (company Q4 2025 release) and record drilling/completion efficiency in Q2 2026
30+ years of undrilled Marcellus inventory (company) with proved reserves of 18.1 Tcfe at YE2025 — a resource life in-basin peers cannot replicate

Marketing and transport portfolio escapes Appalachia basis: realized price including hedges was a $0.64 per mcfe premium to NYMEX in Q2 2026, and pre-hedge NGL realizations carried a $3.49/bbl premium over Mont Belvieu (Q2 2026 release)

Repaired balance sheet: net debt $1,198,130,000 at YE2025 (dcf_numbers.json; 0.8x debt/EBITDAX per the company) and down to about $881M by Q2 2026, with buybacks and a rising dividend funded from free cash flow
moat_justification: A real but narrow cost-and-resource moat, not a franchise: Range sits on low-cost Marcellus rock with 30+ years of inventory and a transport/marketing book that earns premium realizations over NYMEX and Mont Belvieu, which is worth something through a cycle. Against that it is a pure price-taker in a single basin whose reserves deplete and whose returns are the commodity cycle itself — filed ROE swung from -43% (FY2020) to +41% (FY2022), and fundamentals.json carries no roic_proxy series (operating income is untagged), so there is no evidence of through-cycle returns well above the cost of capital. That is a 4/10: better rock and costs than the average E&P, no pricing power. CAP = 2 + 1.3 x 4 = 7.2 years.

sbc_override.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under the engine's tags: AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense was last filed for FY2017 ($82,776,000) and ShareBasedCompensation ends in FY2013, so the expense survives only in the equity statement (the ALLY situation in this sweep). The cash-flow statement's combined 'Deferred and stock-based compensation' line ($67,849,000 / $53,864,000 / $48,153,000 for FY2023/24/25) is NOT used: it bundles cash-settled deferred compensation with equity SBC. The engine applies this single value to every missing period; against the true per-year equity-statement figures it overstates FY2023 SBC by $5,645,000 (conservative direction) and understates FY2025 SBC by $3,756,000 — both immaterial against OCF of ~$1B. Against the last engine-filed SBC value ($82,776,000, FY2017) the value is 0.51x, inside the 0.1x-10x band.
sbc_override.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-24, accession 0001193125-26-067292), Consolidated Statements of Stockholders' Equity, line 'Stock-based compensation expense' (credited to additional paid-in capital; EDGAR tag AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalSharebasedCompensationRequisiteServicePeriodRecognitionValue): $45,828,000 for FY2025, $42,072,000 for FY2024 and $36,427,000 for FY2023; the override value is the median of the three filed years (the FY2024 figure).
